questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen zěnme chēnghu nín hǎo ne?

answers.answer_text: How should we address you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lái zhèli cānguān fǎngwènde rén dōu jiào wǒ Lǎo Wáng.

answers.answer_text: People who come here to visit all call me Lǎo Wáng.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín xiǎng zhèijiàn shì zěnme ānpái bǐjiào hǎo?

answers.answer_text: What do you think would be the best way to arrange this?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ xiǎng zuì hǎo děng wǒ hé Shànghǎi fāngmiàn liánxì yíxià zài shuō.

answers.answer_text: I think it would be best to wait until I've contacted Shànghǎi and then we'll see about it.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō nín duì zhèi yídàide fāngyán hěn yǒu yánjiū.

answers.answer_text: I've heard that you're an expert on the dialect of this area.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǎli! Wǒ zhǐ shi liǎojiě yìdiǎnr, tánbudào yǒu yánjiū.

answers.answer_text: Oh no! I just know a little about it; I couldn't say I'm an expert.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiànzài Zhōngguó yòngde shíyóu dàbùfen shi zìjǐ shēngchǎnde, duì ba?

answers.answer_text: China now produces most of the oil that it uses, isn't that right?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù, quánbù shi zìjǐ shēngchǎnde.

answers.answer_text: No, they produce all of it.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dàbùfen běifāng rén dōu huì shuō pǔtōnghuà, duì bu duì?

answers.answer_text: Most northerners can speak the standard language, can't they?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ou, bù zhǐ shi běifāng rén, hěn duō nánfāng rénde pǔtōnghuà yě bú cuò.

answers.answer_text: Oh, not just northerners. A lot of southerners speak standard Chinese pretty well, too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Míngtian wǒ jiù cóng Shēnzhèn lí jìng le.

answers.answer_text: Tomorrow I'm going to leave the country from Shēnzhèn.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ou, zhème kuài! Wǒ hái yǐwéi nǐ néng gēn wǒmen dào Sūzhōu qù wánr jǐtian ne!

answers.answer_text: Oh, so soon! I thought you could go with us to Sūzhōu for a few days.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dōngběi, Xīběi nǐ dōu qùguo le ba?

answers.answer_text: You've been to Manchuria and the Northwest, haven't you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài Dōngběi wǒ zhǐ cānguānle Dàqìng, Xīběi hái méi qù ne.

answers.answer_text: In Manchuria I've only visited Dàqìng, and I haven't been to the Northwest yet.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ xiān zǒu hǎo le, wǒ jiù lái.

answers.answer_text: You go ahead and leave. I'll be right there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo. Huí tóu jiàn.

answers.answer_text: Okay. See you in a while.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèiwèi xuézhě yánjiūde shi něi fāngmiànde wèntí?

answers.answer_text: What subject does this scholar study?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā yánjiūde zhǔyào shi yǔyán hé yǔyánxué.

answers.answer_text: She mainly studies languages and linguistics.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài Xīnjiāng Nèiměng yídài méiyou hěn duō rén shuō pǔtōnghuà ba?

answers.answer_text: In the region of Xīnjiāng and Inner Mongolia not many people speak standard Chinese, do they?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duì, zài nèixiē dìfang, shǎoshù mínzú yǔyán zhàn zhǔyàode dìwèi.

answers.answer_text: Right. In those places the minority nationality languages occupy the major position.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen xiǎng qùde dìqū quán dōu qù le ba? Hái yǒu shénme wèntí meiyou?

answers.answer_text: Have you been to all the regions you wanted to go to? Do you have any more questions?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Méiyou shénme wèntí le, Lǚxíngshède gōngzuò gǎode hěn hǎo, wǒmen hěn mǎnyì.

answers.answer_text: We don't have any more questions. The China Travel Service did a very good job and we're very pleased.
